'''Eva Hevia''' is a Professor of [[Organometallic chemistry|Organometallic Chemistry]] at the [[University of Strathclyde]], Glasgow and Professor at the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry, the University of Bern.

== Education ==
Hevia was born in [[Gijón]] in 1976.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|url=http://evaheviagroup.com/bio.html|title=Bio|website=evaheviagroup.com|access-date=2018-03-27}}</ref> She became interested in a science at a very young age.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.madrimasd.org/cienciaysociedad/entrevistas/revista-madrimasd/detalleEmpresa.asp?id=745|title=madri+d. Entrevista a: Eva Hevia|website=www.madrimasd.org|access-date=2018-03-27}}</ref> She earned her Masters and PhD from the [[University of Oviedo]] in 2002.<ref name=":0" /><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.uniovi.es/-/la-gijonesa-eva-hevia-premiada-en-reino-unido-por-su-trayectoria-investigadora?redirect=/comunicacion/resumenmedios|title=Universidad de Oviedo - La gijonesa Eva Hevia, premiada en Reino Unido por su trayectoria investigadora - Noticia|last=Innovación|first=Centro de|website=www.uniovi.es|language=es-ES|access-date=2018-03-27|archive-date=2018-03-28|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180328041251/https://www.uniovi.es/-/la-gijonesa-eva-hevia-premiada-en-reino-unido-por-su-trayectoria-investigadora?redirect=/comunicacion/resumenmedios|url-status=dead}}</ref>

== Research ==
Hevia was appointed a [[Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions|Marie Skłodowska-Curie]] Fellow at the [[University of Strathclyde]] working with Robert Mulvey<ref>https://www.strath.ac.uk/staff/mulveyrobertprof/</ref> in 2006. She became Senior Lecturer in 2010 and Reader in 2011.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|url=http://www.rsc.org/ScienceAndTechnology/Awards/CordayMorganPrizes/2017-Winner-Hevia.asp|title=RSC Corday-Morgan Prize 2017 Winner|website=www.rsc.org|language=en|access-date=2018-03-27}}</ref> She was appointed Professor at the [[University of Strathclyde]] in 2013, when she was only 38 years old.<ref name=":2">{{Cite news|url=https://sruk.org.uk/eva-hevia-professor-university-strathclyde-glasgow-receives-2016-sruk-emerging-talent-award/|title=Eva Hevia, professor at the University of Strathclyde in Glasgow, receives the 2016 SRUK Emerging Talent Award - Sruk|date=2016-12-12|work=Sruk|access-date=2018-03-27|language=en-US|archive-date=2019-04-30|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190430115808/https://sruk.org.uk/eva-hevia-professor-university-strathclyde-glasgow-receives-2016-sruk-emerging-talent-award/|url-status=dead}}</ref> Since February 2019 Eva is a Professor in [[Inorganic Chemistry]] at the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at the [[University of Bern]].

When receiving the 2016 SRUK Emerging Talent Award, Eva Hevia was named by Professor Morata, who was chair of the Award's scientific committee, as "one of the strongest and most promising researchers in her field at international level."<ref name=":5" />

Hevia's research is in polar [[organometallic chemistry]]. Her research group are interested in the development of multicomponent reagents containing earth-abundant metals for synthesis. The chemistry uses the cooperative effects of two metals, which allows of new areas of chemistry based on metal-mediated organic synthesis and building supramolecular structures.<ref name=":3">{{Cite web|url=https://www.youngacademyofscotland.org.uk/members/evahevia.html|title=YAS Members - Eva Hevia|website=www.youngacademyofscotland.org.uk|language=en-gb|access-date=2018-03-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190430115858/https://www.youngacademyofscotland.org.uk/members/evahevia.html|archive-date=2019-04-30|url-status=dead}}</ref> These areas include: metallation for [[Chemoselectivity|chemoselective]] functionalisation of organic molecules,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Hernán-Gómez|first=Alberto|last2=Herd|first2=Emma|last3=Uzelac|first3=Marina|last4=Cadenbach|first4=Thomas|last5=Kennedy|first5=Alan R.|last6=Borilovic|first6=Ivana|last7=Aromı́|first7=Guillem|last8=Hevia|first8=Eva|date=2015-06-08|title=Zincate-Mediated Arylation Reactions of Acridine: Pre- and Postarylation Structural Insights|journal=Organometallics|volume=34|issue=11|pages=2614–2623|doi=10.1021/om501251q|issn=0276-7333|url=https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/55842/1/Hern_n_G_mez_etal_Organometallics_2016_Zincate_mediated_arylation_reactions_of_acridine.pdf}}</ref> sensitive anion trapping,<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Martínez‐Martínez|first=Antonio J.|last2=Fuentes|first2=M. Ángeles|last3=Hernán‐Gómez|first3=Alberto|last4=Hevia|first4=Eva|last5=Kennedy|first5=Alan R.|last6=Mulvey|first6=Robert E.|last7=O'Hara|first7=Charles T.|date=2015-11-16|title=Alkali‐Metal‐Mediated Magnesiations of an N‐Heterocyclic Carbene: Normal, Abnormal, and "Paranormal" Reactivity in a Single Tritopic Molecule|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition|language=en|volume=54|issue=47|pages=14075–14079|doi=10.1002/anie.201507586|pmid=26417985|issn=1521-3773|url=https://strathprints.strath.ac.uk/54271/1/Martinez_Martinez_etal_ACIE_2015_Alkali_metal_mediated_magnesiations_of_an_NHC.pdf}}</ref> [[deep eutectic solvent]]s and salt supported organometallic reagents<ref>{{Cite journal|last=García‐Álvarez|first=Joaquin|last2=Hevia|first2=Eva|last3=Capriati|first3=Vito|date=2015-11-01|title=Reactivity of Polar Organometallic Compounds in Unconventional Reaction Media: Challenges and Opportunities (Eur. J. Org. Chem. 31/2015)|journal=European Journal of Organic Chemistry|language=en|volume=2015|issue=31|pages=n/a|doi=10.1002/ejoc.201590088|issn=1099-0690}}</ref> and the catalytic applications of cooperative bimetallics.<ref>{{Cite journal|last=Armstrong|first=David R.|last2=Clegg|first2=William|last3=García-Alvarez|first3=Pablo|last4=McCall|first4=Matthew D.|last5=Nuttall|first5=Lorraine|last6=Kennedy|first6=Alan R.|last7=Russo|first7=Luca|last8=Hevia|first8=Eva|date=2011-04-11|title=Shedding New Light on ZnCl2-Mediated Addition Reactions of Grignard Reagents to Ketones: Structural Authentication of Key Intermediates and Diffusion-Ordered NMR Studies|journal=Chemistry - A European Journal|language=en|volume=17|issue=16|pages=4470–4479|doi=10.1002/chem.201002544|pmid=21365695|issn=1521-3765|hdl=10651/9710|hdl-access=free}}</ref> Her recent focus has been on the activation of [[N-heterocyclic carbene|N-heterocyclic]] molecules and [[green chemistry]].<ref name=":1" /> Her research will have applications in pharmacology and [[agricultural chemistry]], and will have profound implications on the environment.<ref name=":2" />

Hevia has given over a hundred invited talks and lectures worldwide.<ref>{{Cite web|url=http://evaheviagroup.com/talks.html|title=Talks|website=evaheviagroup.com|access-date=2018-03-27}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=http://www.fundacionareces.tv/watch/cienciauk2017?as=5a3a695efe7e81712e8b4569|title=CienciaUK 2017: La carrera investigadora y otras profesiones científicas en Reino Unido|website=www.fundacionareces.tv|language=es|access-date=2018-03-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180328041301/http://www.fundacionareces.tv/watch/cienciauk2017?as=5a3a695efe7e81712e8b4569|archive-date=2018-03-28|url-status=dead}}</ref>
